scenarios.name: Insert a separator after a selected custom panel row

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" and then "3D Annotations" in the available list
the custom panel list contains "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations"
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list
the user selects "<Separator>" in the available list
the user clicks the right transfer button
the custom panel list contains these rows in order:
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
